# KithMoot Vision

> Experimental local face detection and foreground matting, with a Rust and WASM runtime and model-review tools.

## Documentation

- [Runtime and workshop](https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot-vision/blob/main/README.md): Integrate from source and check model, data and release boundaries.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot-vision): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [kithmoot](https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot): First consumer of the local inference component.
